desk.headline: Revenue up 32% to $237.5m, above its own guidance and estimates; full-year revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance raised
results: Revenue rose 32% to $237.5m (8% up on Q2), well above the company's own $217–222m Q3 guidance.
Adjusted EBITDA rose 45% to $144.9m and the margin widened to 61% from 56%.
Net income was $86.7m ($0.47 a diluted share) against a loss a year ago, helped by a $14.4m gain on revaluing a deal-related payout.
Cash flow from operations over the last 12 months doubled to $303m; free cash flow was $249m.
Long-term debt fell to $1.39bn from $1.80bn at end-2025 after IPO proceeds paid down loans.

guidance.summary: Liftoff raised its 2026 revenue range to $907–912m from $870–880m and adjusted EBITDA to $547–551m from $510–518m. For Q4 it expects revenue of $244–249m and adjusted EBITDA of $150–154m.

points: The CEO said results beat the top of guidance, with strength across key app categories.
He said better results for advertisers led them to spend more on the platform.
The CFO stressed durable, profitable growth and strong cash generation as the focus.
call.source: CEO and CFO comments in the results release; no call coverage found

watch: Whether Q4 revenue lands in the $244–249m range in the seasonally strong holiday quarter.
Further debt reduction from cash flow (long-term debt $1.39bn).
From Q1 2027 the company will stop reporting Core Advertising revenue separately.
